# StateSet iCommerce

> The SQLite of commerce: an embedded, local-first commerce engine for AI
> agents and applications. Orders, inventory, customers, products, carts,
> payments, returns, subscriptions, promotions, analytics, full finance
> (GL, month-end close, AP/AR, fixed assets, revenue recognition), warehouse
> management, and traceability — in-process, one database file, exact-decimal
> money, no external services.

Install (all published and verified):
- Rust: `cargo add stateset-sdk --features full`
- Node: `npm install @stateset/embedded`
- Python: `pip install stateset-embedded`
- MCP (Claude Desktop/Cursor): `npx -y @stateset/cli stateset-mcp --db ./store.db`
  (900+ tools; writes need `--apply`)

## Docs

- [Agent quickstart](https://github.com/stateset/stateset-icommerce/blob/master/docs/src/ai-agents.md): MCP + OpenAI/LangChain/Vercel-AI/CrewAI adapters with working code
- [Getting started](https://github.com/stateset/stateset-icommerce/blob/master/docs/src/getting-started.md): install + first commerce operations per language
- [Tool catalog](https://github.com/stateset/stateset-icommerce/blob/master/cli/docs/TOOLS.md): generated list of every MCP tool and its schema
- [Rust API](https://docs.rs/stateset-sdk): crate docs (all 17 crates build green)
- [Money contract](https://github.com/stateset/stateset-icommerce/blob/master/docs/src/advanced/money.md): why money is exact-decimal and how that is enforced
- [Trust foundation](https://github.com/stateset/stateset-icommerce/blob/master/TRUST_FOUNDATION.md): verifiability, audit, and compatibility guarantees
